title: Did anyone else experience this last night.
content: I was having a very lucid dream last night, I feel it was very important, there was a older woman who felt like she had some importance and was telling me things and showing me things all of a sudden I snapped out of the dream and woke up. Everything from what she said to what I saw is all just a blur like it’s been wiped from my mind . No matter how much I try to think and re evaluate what happened it’s like there is a block in my mind and my head even gets a small headache when I try to think further into the dream from last night……..
